$comment: Launch-compliance fixes, 26 Sep 2026, from the audit of the same date (LegalAId-Launch-Compliance-Audit).
Engineering changes only. Policy wording is drafted for an advocate in docs/legal/ and is not in force. Nothing here is legal advice.
Pinned by tests/launchCompliance.test.mjs (18 checks, each mutation-tested: a reintroduced claim, a removed server-side age check and an account deletion that skipped versions all fail it).
review_status: UNREVIEWED — engineering changes; policy drafts await an advocate.

fixed_in_code.change: Removed court-ready, certified, execution-ready, designed to be enforceable, We do not guess, Lawyers-first, Free forever, 16+ document types, enterprise offers, Certified labels; 'legal validation' reworded as automated checks that are not a legal review; repealed Payment of Wages and Maternity Benefit Acts replaced by the Code on Wages and Code on Social Security.
One notice (frontend/src/data/legalNotice.js = backend/services/legalNotice.js, tested identical) on the form, editor, sign-up, footer and Terms, and printed last in every DOCX, PDF and TXT export.

fixed_in_code.item: Export change and the provenance gate
fixed_in_code.change: The export notice is a deliberate output change. Before re-capture the conservation gate reported exactly 138 violations, all text_sha256 (the plain-text export of the 138 shipping cases); results, disclosures and clause order were identical. Recorded in provenance-instrumentation.json → the_gate.rebaselines.
18+ confirmation and Terms/Privacy acceptance required by the server (boolean true only) and recorded on the user with the accepted versions and time.
The intake form states that answers go to Google Gemini (Groq as fallback), are processed outside India, and include other people's details.

Was a timer that showed 'Message sent'. Now POST /contact delivers to CONTACT_EMAIL with the sender as reply-to, rate limited (5 per 15 min), with a honeypot; refuses with 503 when CONTACT_EMAIL is unset. Dead legalaid.in addresses removed.
emailService passed reply_to, which the Resend SDK v6 and nodemailer both ignore; now replyTo.

PATCH /auth/me (name, phone), GET /auth/me/export (account, consent, drafts, versions; no secrets), DELETE /auth/me (password-confirmed; deletes versions, drafts, account; clears the session). Profile page 'Your data' card. PATCH/DELETE stay on the brute-force rate limit.

Factual corrections only: what is collected and why, named processors and that they are outside India, retention as the code implements it, the one cookie, 18+, the new data-rights controls. The false statement that users could edit details in their profile is now true.
Self-hosted via @fontsource (OFL 1.1); no page load reaches Google Fonts.

Proprietary LICENSE; UNLICENSED in all five package.json files (was an accidental ISC); frontend/public/third-party-notices.txt covering all 33 bundled packages and the Lucide/Feather icons, linked from the footer, regenerated by scripts/generateFrontendNotices.mjs and checked by the test.
docs/THIRD_PARTY_SERVICES.md: every service, data, location, training, retention, plan status; jszip used under MIT.

for_the_owner: Set CONTACT_EMAIL (backend, on Render) and VITE_CONTACT_EMAIL (frontend, on Vercel) to a mailbox you read, on a domain you own. Until then the contact form answers 'not set up yet'.
Confirm the Gemini project's Billing Tier shows Paid in AI Studio.
Move Render off plan: free; confirm Vercel is on Pro.
Turn on zero data retention in Groq; confirm the Atlas cluster region.
Commission an original logo (the gavel is a stock Lucide icon).
for_the_advocate: docs/legal/PRIVACY_POLICY_DRAFT.md and docs/legal/TERMS_OF_SERVICE_DRAFT.md, with their marked questions.
The wording of the legal notice (one constant in each of the two legalNotice.js files).
How LegalAId must describe itself under the Advocates Act and Bar Council of India rules.
not_done_yet: Automatic deletion of inactive and unverified accounts: needs retention periods decided first (see the privacy draft, section 5).
Changing the sign-in email from the Profile (needs re-verification); handled through Contact for now.
Existing accounts have no consent record; they should be asked to accept the Terms on next sign-in once the final Terms are approved.
